findings.summary: negative-control citation names the wrong importer part
findings.text: docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once-s120.html:93: the negative-control sentence says both failing ids sit in "the base importer arm's first part log", but they are in gates/base-importer-01-all_debug.log (part 01); part 00 contains neither id, so a reader following the citation to the first part finds the case that is not there.

item_verdicts.diff: read the six commits f69887117f..79a79f0603; two files changed, +53-16 in reckon/crew/obligations.py (a from_store helper threaded through _run_namings and the aggregate-completion loop) and +11-7 in the evidence fragment (gate figures and revision).
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_an_unchanged_sweep_reads_no_plan_and_walks_no_tree.py and requires the head arm to add no failure with both arms' logs carrying revision, literal command and a closing EXIT; the head fence arm at 95b4a02d56 reports 79 passed with EXIT=0 and the base arm 6 failed, 69 passed with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is an obligations sweep that reads no plan and walks no file tree over an unchanged state; the gained commits at reckon/crew/obligations.py:4494 complete the held-tree aggregate for every reader's undelivered rows, which is the history this sweep files from.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, fourteen commits ending 79a79f0603, the tests line naming four test files, and the head/base gate logs under gates/, and its 79-passed head and 6-failed base figures match the logs I opened.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares ten write paths; the gained commits touch exactly docs/evidence/fragments/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once/the-monitor-reads-each-fact-once-s120.html and reckon/crew/obligations.py, both inside that declaration.

justifications.durability: the gained commits add no test and tests/test_held_worktrees_read_run_files.py passes nine at both base and head, though tests/test_held_worktree_fallback_resolves_each_row_once.py:273 checks the run-less row against an independent ledger reference.
justifications.evidence: gates/head-fence-all_debug.log reports 79 passed in 60.28s and gates/base-fence-all_debug.log 6 failed, 69 passed in 32.30s, and the importer parts agree with the manifest's 44-failed head against 63-failed base.
justifications.fit: the helper at reckon/crew/obligations.py:3769 follows the module's extracted-predicate idiom and from_store is named for the reader it selects.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/obligations.py:4494 computes from_store once and 4552 uses it to file only the aggregate rows the answering reader could not deliver, completing the history the sweep reads without a second read.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/obligations.py:3769 extracts the predicate both readers need and calls open_run_index.matches_sources, the owner of that check, rather than forking a second rule.
justifications.scope_discipline: the gained diff touches only the evidence fragment and reckon/crew/obligations.py, both on the manifest's declared write paths.
